description.value: Olove Greek Kitchen is a family-run Greek restaurant on East Hastings Street in Burnaby, serving traditional dishes like moussaka, grilled octopus, housemade spanakopita, and souvlaki wraps stuffed with house-cut chips in the Greek street-food style. The kitchen carries a warm, playful brand voice rooted in home-cooking, and the menu caters to a range of dietary needs including a dedicated vegan option. Takeout is available alongside full dine-in service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The olovegreek.ca website confirms an active Greek restaurant at 5931 Hastings Street, Burnaby, with phone 604 620-3414 and address matching OSM exactly. The Location & Hours page explicitly labels a 'Take Out' service option, the dinner menu lists a dedicated VEGAN Goddess Bowl plus falafel and multiple vegetarian dishes, and the Health & Safety page references cleaning 'washroom facilities,' confirming on-site washrooms. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website header consistently displays the name as 'O'LOVE GREEK KITCHEN' (with apostrophe), while OSM records it as 'Olove Greek Kitchen' — minor branding discrepancy worth noting but not a data-quality blocker.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, independently run Greek restaurant on a Burnaby cycling corridor with confirmed takeout and strong vegetarian/vegan menu options — a practical and appealing food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address orders@olovegreek.ca appears on the Location & Hours page but is absent from OSM tags.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dinner menu includes a VEGAN Goddess Bowl, FALAFEL souva, SPANAKOPITA (organic spinach), BOUREKAKIA (organic wild greens and feta), KOUNOUPITHI (cauliflower), and multiple vegetarian dips and salads. No GF labelling found
